messages.welcome:
**Welcome to MGSV: Joint Operations, by Hound Protocol.**
We are building a multiplayer mod for Metal Gear Solid V on PC: online play for up to 16 players in the single-player world, for Windows and Linux through Proton.

1. Read <#rules>.
2. Check the live roadmap in <#roadmap>.
3. Want to help? Open contracts are on the website: https://hound-protocol.github.io/Joint-Operations/#/contribute

This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami.
messages.rules:
**Rules**
1. MGSV: Joint Operations is an unofficial fan project by Hound Protocol. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami.
2. Own your copy of MGSV. No piracy, cracks or game-file sharing.
3. No cheating in other people's multiplayer, and nothing that touches Konami's online services or anti-cheat.
4. Be respectful. No harassment, hate or spam.
5. Keep discussion in the right channel. Credit your sources.
6. Bug reports use the template in <#bug-reports>.
7. Never share passwords, tokens or keys.
8. Moderators have the final say.

Full code of conduct: https://hound-protocol.github.io/Joint-Operations/#/docs/conduct

messages.faq:
**FAQ**
**Is it playable?** Not yet. See the roadmap.
**Is it co-op?** It is a multiplayer mod: online play for up to 16 players in the single-player world.
**Do I need the game?** Yes, your own copy of MGSV on Steam.
**Linux?** Yes, through Proton.
**How do I help?** https://hound-protocol.github.io/Joint-Operations/#/contribute
